bonuses.name: Monotask
bonuses.text: Choose a single non-combat/social skill. The servitor is considered to have a total value of 5 in that skill.

bonuses.name: Incantation of the Iron Soul
bonuses.text: Servitors are unaffected by powers and abilities that affect the mind.

bonuses.name: Wargear
bonuses.text: A servitor is often equipped with a single tool appropriate to its task, such as a combi-tool for a repair servitor or a diagnostor for a medical servitor. This tool is integrated into the servitor’s body and neither needs power nor can be removed without killing the servitor.

abilities.name: Attacks
abilities.text: A monotask servitor is not programmed for combat, and generally cannot attack. Use the Combat Servitor profile (Core Rulebook) for a servitor that is built for warfare.
